intro.text: Tarn the Tonk, a Kezare street hustler working for the crime lord Sharezan, nicknamed after the slow-witted sandling used to carry loads.

items.text: When the trackts offered sanctuary to anyone willing to inform on Sharezan, Tarn turned up dead in the street with the back of his skull smashed in and a warning note from Sharezan on him. Ais judged the note had been left after he died.
